# Clipping Tool Free By AI

> Free, open-source AI clipping tool (also called Podcast Shorts Factory / NUO). Ten cooperating AI agents turn long YouTube videos, including GTA 6 (GTA VI) content and podcasts, into vertical 9:16 Shorts and can post them to YouTube Shorts. MIT licensed, Python, FastAPI, ffmpeg, faster-whisper.

## Key facts
- Cost: free; defaults to free AI providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama)
- Platforms: YouTube Shorts automated; TikTok and Reels exported for manual posting
- Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux; Python 3.11+ and ffmpeg required
- Interfaces: command line (factory auto <url>) and web dashboard (python webapp/server.py, port 8787)
